description: This Java class defines the configuration for a background synchronization process in a service, encapsulating various timing, throughput, and retry parameters, and providing methods to parse and access the configuration data.

classes.name: DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing BackgroundSyncConfig, managing configuration for background sync with parsing, equality, and string representation methods.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: fromUpdaterConfig
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig using a fallback updater configuration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether background sync is enabled.

methods.name: getQuietPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration of the quiet period between sync operations.

methods.name: getKeptEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of events to keep.

methods.name: getToleranceWindow
methods.description: Returns the duration within which out-of-date search index entries are tolerated without reindexing.

methods.name: getThrottleThroughput
methods.description: Returns the number of things to update per throttle period.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration before the stream stalls if no elements pass through.

methods.name: getPolicyAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for policy shard region requests.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration for retries.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration for retries.

methods.name: getMaxRestarts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of restart attempts.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration object.
